```sql
SELECT p.poi_name
FROM pois p
ORDER BY p.geometry <-> (
  SELECT ST_Centroid(r.geometry)
  FROM regions r
  WHERE r.region_name ILIKE '%Linthicum%' AND r.border_type = 'city'
  LIMIT 1
) * ST_Azimuth(
  (
    SELECT ST_Centroid(r.geometry)
    FROM regions r
    WHERE r.region_name ILIKE '%Linthicum%' AND r.border_type = 'city'
    LIMIT 1
  ),
  (
    SELECT p2.geometry
    FROM pois p2
    WHERE p2.poi_name ILIKE '%National Electronics Museum%'
    LIMIT 1
  )
) DESC
WHERE p.amenity = 'cafe' AND p.poi_name NOT ILIKE '%Battle of the Bulge Memorial%'
LIMIT 1;
```

```sql
SELECT p.poi_name, ST_Distance(p.geometry::geography, r.geometry::geography) AS distance_meters
FROM pois p
CROSS JOIN LATERAL (
  SELECT ST_MakeLine(
    (SELECT geometry FROM pois WHERE poi_name ILIKE '%Meadow Museum%' AND addr_city ILIKE '%Benson%' LIMIT 1),
    (SELECT geometry FROM parks WHERE park_name ILIKE '%Smithfield Community Park%' LIMIT 1)
  ) AS geometry
) r
WHERE p.amenity = 'fast_food'
  AND ST_DWithin(p.geometry::geography, r.geometry::geography, 1000)
ORDER BY p.geometry <-> r.geometry
LIMIT 1;
```

```sql
SELECT 
    t.poi_name,
    t.geometry,
    ST_Distance(t.geometry::geography, h.geometry::geography) AS distance_meters
FROM 
    pois t
CROSS JOIN LATERAL (
    SELECT geometry FROM pois 
    WHERE poi_name ILIKE '%Hebrew Senior Care%' 
    AND addr_city ILIKE '%West Hartford%' 
    AND addr_state ILIKE '%CT%' 
    LIMIT 1
) h
CROSS JOIN LATERAL (
    SELECT geometry FROM pois 
    WHERE poi_name ILIKE '%University of New Haven New London Campus%' 
    AND addr_city ILIKE '%New London%' 
    AND addr_state ILIKE '%CT%' 
    LIMIT 1
) u
WHERE 
    t.amenity = 'hotel'
    AND ST_DWithin(t.geometry::geography, h.geometry::geography, 100000) -- 100 km buffer
ORDER BY 
    t.geometry::geography <-> ST_MakePoint((ST_Centroid(h.geometry)).x, (ST_Centroid(h.geometry)).y)
LIMIT 1;
```

```sql
SELECT pois.poi_name, ST_Distance(pois.geometry::geography, roads.geometry::geography) AS distance_meters
FROM pois
JOIN roads ON ST_Intersects(pois.geometry, roads.geometry::geography)
WHERE pois.amenity = 'fast_food'
  AND ST_Intersects(roads.geometry, (
    SELECT geometry FROM regions 
    WHERE region_name ILIKE '%Plainfield%' AND border_type = 'city'
    LIMIT 1
  ))
  AND ST_Intersects(roads.geometry, (
    SELECT geometry FROM regions 
    WHERE region_name ILIKE '%Cranston%' AND border_type = 'city'
    LIMIT 1
  ))
  AND ST_DWithin(roads.geometry::geography, (
    SELECT geometry FROM pois 
    WHERE poi_name ILIKE '%Cardiovascular Institute of New England%' 
      AND addr_city ILIKE '%Cranston%'
    LIMIT 1
  ), 10000)
  AND ST_DWithin(roads.geometry::geography, (
    SELECT geometry FROM regions 
    WHERE region_name ILIKE '%Sugar Brook Field Trial and Wildlife Management Area%'
    LIMIT 1
  ), 10000)
ORDER BY pois.geometry::geography <-> (
  SELECT geometry FROM regions 
  WHERE region_name ILIKE '%Sugar Brook Field Trial and Wildlife Management Area%'
  LIMIT 1
) ASC
LIMIT 1;
```

```sql
SELECT r.road_name, ST_Distance(r.geometry::geography, ST_MakeLine(
    (SELECT geometry FROM pois WHERE poi_name ILIKE '%Top of the Rock%' LIMIT 1),
    (SELECT geometry FROM pois WHERE poi_name ILIKE '%Jay Heritage Center%' LIMIT 1)
)::geography) AS distance_meters
FROM roads r
WHERE ST_Intersects(r.geometry, ST_MakeLine(
    (SELECT geometry FROM pois WHERE poi_name ILIKE '%Top of the Rock%' LIMIT 1),
    (SELECT geometry FROM pois WHERE poi_name ILIKE '%Jay Heritage Center%' LIMIT 1)
))
AND r.highway IN ('motorway', 'primary', 'secondary', 'tertiary', 'residential', 'road')
ORDER BY r.geometry <-> ST_MakeLine(
    (SELECT geometry FROM pois WHERE poi_name ILIKE '%Top of the Rock%' LIMIT 1),
    (SELECT geometry FROM pois WHERE poi_name ILIKE '%Jay Heritage Center%' LIMIT 1)
)
LIMIT 1;
```

```sql
SELECT r.road_name, ST_Distance(r.geometry::geography, ST_MakeLine(ST_Centroid(p1.geometry), ST_Centroid(p2.geometry))::geography) AS distance_meters
FROM roads r
JOIN LATERAL (
    SELECT ST_Centroid(geometry) AS geometry
    FROM pois
    WHERE poi_name ILIKE '%Out of Africa Wildlife Park%' AND addr_city ILIKE '%Camp Verde%' AND addr_state ILIKE '%AZ%'
    LIMIT 1
) p1 ON ST_DWithin(r.geometry::geography, p1.geometry::geography, 1000)
JOIN LATERAL (
    SELECT ST_Centroid(geometry) AS geometry
    FROM pois
    WHERE poi_name ILIKE '%7 Wonders Gallery%' AND addr_city ILIKE '%Flagstaff%' AND addr_state ILIKE '%AZ%'
    LIMIT 1
) p2 ON ST_DWithin(r.geometry::geography, p2.geometry::geography, 1000)
JOIN pois c ON ST_DWithin(c.geometry::geography, r.geometry::geography, 100)
WHERE c.amenity = 'cafe'
ORDER BY distance_meters ASC
LIMIT 1;
```

```sql
ORDER BY geometry <-> (SELECT geometry FROM pois WHERE poi_name ILIKE '%Lore Degenstein Art Gallery%' AND addr_city ILIKE '%Selinsgrove%' LIMIT 1)
LIMIT 1;
```
